# Experiment E6 of docs/spec/text-component.md, section 8.7: how chat shows the style, the legacy codes and the object contents.
# Source: screenshots of the window of the vanilla client. The images are e6-style.png, e6-style-2.png, e6-codes-1.png, e6-codes-2.png and e6-objects.png.
# The player is the offline test player Recorder. The vanilla client of the project version joined the vanilla server
# on 127.0.0.1. The server ran in offline mode. The console of the server gave each command.
# A marker line "[Server] @@vis-..." precedes the cases of each image. The cases follow the rows of the image from top to bottom.
# The code character is the section sign. A "legacy code" is that character with the character that follows it.
#
# image e6-style.png
# case STY-a
> tellraw Recorder {text:"P",color:"red",bold:true,extra:[{text:"C",bold:false},{text:"D",color:"blue"},{text:"E",italic:true}]}
# observed: P red and bold. C red and not bold. D blue and bold. E red, bold and italic.
# case STY-b
> tellraw Recorder {text:"UUU",underlined:true,extra:[{text:"NNN",underlined:false},{text:"UUU"}]}
# observed: the first UUU underlined. NNN not underlined. The second UUU underlined.
# case STY-c
> tellraw Recorder {translate:"%s-%s-%s",color:"red",bold:false,with:[{text:"a",color:"blue"},{text:"b",bold:true},"c"],extra:["!"]}
# observed: "a-b-c!" with a blue, b red and bold, the hyphens, c and ! red and not bold.
# case STY-d
> tellraw Recorder {translate:"%s>%s",color:"red",with:[{text:"a",color:"blue",extra:["a2"]},"b"],extra:["e"]}
# observed: "aa2>be" with a and a2 blue, the other characters red.
# case STY-e
> tellraw Recorder {translate:"%s %s",color:"green",bold:true,with:[1,true]}
# observed: "1 1" green and bold.
# case STY-font
> tellraw Recorder {text:"ABC ",font:"minecraft:illageralt",extra:[{text:"DEF "},{text:"GHI ",font:"minecraft:default"}]}
# observed: ABC and DEF in the glyphs of the font illageralt. GHI in the glyphs of the default font.
# case STY-g
> tellraw Recorder {text:"BBB",bold:true,extra:[{text:"NNN",bold:false},{text:"BBB"}]}
# observed: the first BBB bold. NNN not bold. The second BBB bold.
# case STY-h
> tellraw Recorder {translate:"%s%s%s",color:"gold",with:[{text:"A",extra:["B"]},"C",{text:"D",color:"aqua"}],extra:["E"]}
# observed: "ABCDE" with D aqua and the other characters gold.
#
# image e6-codes-1.png
# case FMT-a
> tellraw Recorder {text:"a§cb§lc§rd"}
# observed: a white. b red. c red and bold. d white and not bold.
# case FMT-b
> tellraw Recorder {text:"a§cb§rc",color:"blue"}
# observed: a blue. b red. c blue.
# case FMT-c
> tellraw Recorder {text:"§0A§1B§2C§3D§4E§5F§6G§7H"}
# observed: eight colours in the order of the codes 0 to 7: black, dark blue, dark green, dark aqua, dark red, dark purple, gold, gray.
# case FMT-d
> tellraw Recorder {text:"§8A§9B§aC§bD§cE§dF§eG§fH"}
# observed: eight colours in the order of the codes 8 to f: dark gray, blue, green, aqua, red, light purple, yellow, white.
# case FMT-e
> tellraw Recorder {text:"§lB§mS§nU§oI§rN"}
# observed: B bold. S bold and struck through. U bold, struck through and underlined. I the same and italic. N plain.
# case FMT-f
> tellraw Recorder {text:"§lB§cR§lB"}
# observed: B white and bold. R red and not bold. The second B red and bold.
# case FMT-g
> tellraw Recorder {text:"§CR§LB§RN"}
# observed: R red. B red and bold. N white and plain. The upper case letters act as the lower case letters.
# case FMT-h
> tellraw Recorder {text:"§cA",extra:["B"]}
# observed: A red. B white.
# case FMT-i
> tellraw Recorder {text:"a§zb§!c"}
# observed: "abc" in white. Each code that no format has is gone, with the character after the code character.
#
# image e6-codes-2.png
# case FMT-j
> tellraw Recorder {text:"A§",extra:["cB"]}
# observed: "AcB" in white. The code character at the end of a text is gone, and the next text does not start a code.
# case FMT-k
> tellraw Recorder {translate:"§c%s",with:["a"]}
# observed: "a" in white. A code in the pattern does not act on the argument.
# case FMT-l
> tellraw Recorder {text:"§kXXXX§rN"}
# observed: four characters that change at each frame, then N plain.
# case FMT-m
> tellraw Recorder {text:"§aA§rB",color:"red",bold:true}
# observed: A green and bold. B red and bold.
# case FMT-n
> tellraw Recorder {text:"§lB§r§cR",color:"blue"}
# observed: B blue and bold. R red and not bold.
# case FMT-o
> tellraw Recorder {text:"§9§lB§oI§cR"}
# observed: B blue and bold. I blue, bold and italic. R red, not bold and not italic.
# case FMT-p
> tellraw Recorder {text:"NNN§mSSS§nUUU§rN"}
# observed: NNN plain. SSS struck through. UUU struck through and underlined. N plain.
#
# image e6-objects.png
# case OBJ-a
> tellraw Recorder {text:"[",extra:[{atlas:"minecraft:blocks",sprite:"minecraft:block/stone",fallback:"FB"},"]"]}
# observed: the image of the stone sprite between the two brackets.
# case OBJ-b
> tellraw Recorder {text:"[",extra:[{atlas:"minecraft:items",sprite:"minecraft:item/diamond"},"]"]}
# observed: the image of the diamond between the two brackets.
# case OBJ-c
> tellraw Recorder {text:"[",extra:[{player:{id:[I;1,2,3,4]},fallback:"FB"},"]"]}
# observed: the head of the default skin between the two brackets.
# case OBJ-d
> tellraw Recorder {text:"[",extra:[{player:{id:[I;1,2,3,4]},hat:false},"]"]}
# observed: the head of the default skin between the two brackets.
# case OBJ-e
> tellraw Recorder {text:"[",extra:[{atlas:"minecraft:blocks",sprite:"minecraft:block/stone",color:"red",font:"minecraft:illageralt"},"]"]}
# observed: the image of the stone sprite in a red tint between the two brackets.
# case OBJ-f
> tellraw Recorder {translate:"[%s]",with:[{atlas:"minecraft:blocks",sprite:"minecraft:block/dirt",fallback:"FB"}]}
# observed: the image of the dirt sprite between the two brackets.
# case OBJ-g
> tellraw Recorder {text:"[",extra:[{atlas:"minecraft:blocks",sprite:"my:no/such"},"]"]}
# observed: the image of the missing texture, a magenta and black pattern, between the two brackets.
# case OBJ-h
> tellraw Recorder {text:"[",extra:[{atlas:"minecraft:blocks",sprite:"minecraft:block/stone",fallback:""},"]"]}
# observed: the image of the stone sprite between the two brackets.
#
# image e6-style-2.png
# The options file of the client binds the key mapping key.jump to the key X.
# case STY2-strike
> tellraw Recorder {text:"AAA",strikethrough:true,extra:[{text:"BBB"},{text:"CCC",strikethrough:false}]}
# observed: AAA and BBB struck through. CCC not struck through.
# case STY2-italic
> tellraw Recorder {text:"AAA",italic:true,extra:[{text:"BBB"},{text:"CCC",italic:false}]}
# observed: AAA and BBB in italic. CCC not in italic.
# case STY2-obf
> tellraw Recorder {text:"AAA",obfuscated:true,extra:[{text:"BBB"},{text:"CCC",obfuscated:false}]}
# observed: six characters that change at each frame. CCC readable.
# case STY2-shadow
> tellraw Recorder {text:"AAA",shadow_color:-65536,extra:[{text:"BBB"},{text:"CCC",shadow_color:0}]}
# observed: AAA and BBB with a red shadow. CCC with no shadow.
# case STY2-key
> tellraw Recorder {keybind:"key.attack",color:"red",bold:true,extra:["|",{keybind:"key.jump",color:"blue"}]}
# observed: "Left Button|X" in bold. Left Button and the bar red. X blue.
